metadata.description: Lean GitHub Actions and deploy skills: author least-privilege workflows, triage red CI, cut releases, deploy to a tailnet host with no stored secrets.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: gha-author (SHA-pinned, least-privilege, minutes-aware workflows with OIDC references), ci-triage (read-only red-CI diagnosis), release (signed tags, floating major tags), deploy-vps (Tailscale SSH deploy from Actions via OIDC federated identity).
